description: This Java class defines a custom implementation of the WebDriver interface, called DiscoveryOnlyWebDriver, used for 'discovery-only' validation purposes. It is designed to fail fast upon any attempt to perform browser operations, thus verifying test discoverability without requiring actual browser or driver binaries.

classes.name: DiscoveryOnlyWebDriver
classes.description: A WebDriver implementation that prevents any real browser operation, used for validation/testing discoverability without requiring browser binaries.

methods.name: notAllowed
methods.description: Utility method that creates an UnsupportedOperationException indicating WebDriver operations are not permitted in discovery-only mode.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent navigation to a URL.

methods.name: getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent retrieving the current URL.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent retrieving the page title.

methods.name: findElements
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent locating elements.

methods.name: findElement
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent locating a single element.

methods.name: getPageSource
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent getting page source.

methods.name: close
methods.description: No operation (no-op) for closing the driver.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: No operation (no-op) for quitting the driver.

methods.name: getWindowHandles
methods.description: Returns an empty set, representing no open windows.

methods.name: getWindowHandle
methods.description: Returns a fixed string 'DISCOVERY_ONLY' as the window handle.

methods.name: switchTo
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent changing the context.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent navigation actions.

methods.name: manage
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent managing options.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent script execution.

methods.name: executeAsyncScript
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent async script execution.

methods.name: getScreenshotAs
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent taking screenshots.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a minimal Capabilities object with no capabilities advertised.
